{{Quote|You! You have some! I can practically ''smell'' it on you! Give me the spice! Give it to me ''now''!|Urfo|<ref name="Tempest Feud" />}}
'''Urfo''' was a muscular, [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] thug who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endregaad]]<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> during the era of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref> Due to his strength and his skill as a brawler, Urfo was able to obtain jobs as a [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|bouncer]], a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] and a debt collector, and at some point, he was hired by a geode [[Mining/Legends|miner]] to defend a rich geode strike that the miner had discovered in Endregaad's [[Temple Valley]]. However, Urfo became addicted to the potent [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Tempest (spice)|Tempest]], and he came to be the leader of a [[Urfo's gang|gang]] of fellow Tempest addicts. The miner eventually left the valley, leaving Urfo and his gang behind, and the thug became so consumed by his desire for Tempest that he could not be reasoned with.<ref name="Tempest Feud" />
